CYP2D6.description: Activity-score-based phenotype assignment per the CPIC/DPWG 2019 consensus standardizing CYP2D6 AS->phenotype translation (Caudle et al., Clin Transl Sci 2020). Bands are contiguous so no achievable score maps to 'unknown'. Boundaries are encoded as shared inclusive endpoints; the comparator returns the FIRST matching range, so the lower band owns each shared endpoint. The AS=1.0 boundary is assigned to intermediate_metabolizer (the 2019 consensus choice), and AS=2.25 to normal_metabolizer. Bands: PM AS=0; IM 0<AS<=1.0; NM 1.0<AS<=2.25; UM AS>2.25.

CYP2C19.description: Function-pair phenotype assignment per CPIC CYP2C19 guideline.
